proposals.title: A little less still
proposals.body:
I asked her to stop moving.

She curled the arm under me. I caught the next one, then stretched across another. By the time she stopped, I had feet on both sides and no comfortable way to bring them together.

Asked her to move a little.

She asked which way.

proposals.alt: A dark squat lobster with pale lengthwise stripes stands across curled white and dark-lined feather-star arms beside a rough upright fragment.
proposals.canon: Mina remains Allogalathea elegans, living on her feather-star host Rill at Anilao. She wants comfort on her own terms and is less good at specifying them. No new host species, sex, age, mate, molt or home is assigned.
proposals.chronology: Append after Our lunch and Attached. Existing episodes and avatar unchanged. This is a new demand on Rill, not another feeding dispute or romantic guest.
proposals.fictionBoundary: Photograph shows a lobster supported across several curled host arms. Curling in response to the request, sequential grabs, discomfort and dialogue are fictional. No observed motion sequence, deliberate punishment, unusual arm reach or injury is claimed. The rough fragment supplies no premise and is not identified as live host tissue.
proposals.editorialRisk: A compact physical reversal, not a life-changing revelation. Lead should judge whether the concrete mismatch between demanded stillness and needed movement earns a Story. Do not improve it by inventing a predator or another animal.

biologyReferences.basis: 2023 specimen-based taxonomic treatment corroborates A. elegans association with crinoid hosts and distinguishes related species by fine morphology. Photo identification remains the primary observation identification, not independent diagnostic confirmation from stripe color.

heldProseAttempts.title: The view I requested
heldProseAttempts.body: I climbed up to complain about the swaying. By the time I reached her highest arm, I was swaying much farther. She asked whether I had come for the view. I said yes.
heldProseAttempts.reason: The image does not establish the highest arm, and the view excuse repeats impression-management humor without enough physical consequence. Retain as rejected draft, not a second candidate.
